requirement:
The method is declared under {cite}`requirements.sdk.graph.running-criteria.check_inputs`.

The method resolves the recorded dependencies through graph operations and
fingerprinting, comparing each with its saved observation. A fingerprint
mismatch returns `Ok(false)` and permits an early return; it need not resolve
later dependencies. An encountered dependency-resolution failure returns an
error.

The method observes the current state that the caller intends to inspect.
Freshness checking has a separate observation scope from criterion execution.
Checked observations enter the new trace when execution explicitly reads
or delivers them.
A checked snapshot can be reused if it still represents the current state.
rationale:
The reviewed tests cover each obligation in `requirements.sdk.graph.evidence.checking_records`. I reviewed only the supplied test text and did not request implementation source.

- **Fingerprint mismatch returns `Ok(false)`.**
  - `tests/contracts.rs#fn[changing_one_criteria_input_does_not_invalidate_another]` changes one input and asserts `check_inputs` is false for that record and true for an unrelated one.
  - `tests/contracts.rs#fn[dependency_resolution_failures_do_not_execute_or_replace_saved_answers]` changes the outgoing-edge membership and asserts `Ok(false)`.
  - `graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[wildcard_versions_still_check_inputs_and_errors]` covers a changed content fingerprint and a different fingerprint scheme.
  - `graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[labeled_selections_track_only_target_membership_without_reading_contents]` covers edge-set changes.
- **Each dependency is compared, and an earlier match does not hide a later change.** `graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[a_matching_dependency_does_not_hide_a_later_changed_dependency]` covers both a node dependency and an outgoing-edge dependency as the later one. `tests/contracts.rs#fn[absence_certification_is_invalidated_by_the_first_selected_root]` adds an edge-membership mismatch case.
- **A dependency-resolution failure returns an error.**
  - `dependency_resolution_failures_do_not_execute_or_replace_saved_answers` asserts `Err("read")` when the first (node) dependency fails. It asserts `Err("edges")` when the node matches and the later edge dependency fails.
  - `wildcard_versions_still_check_inputs_and_errors` asserts `Err("read")` from `is_current`.
  - `labeled_selections_track_only_target_membership_without_reading_contents` asserts `Err("edges")`.
  - The same test also shows that a failure does not alter the recorded dependencies.
- **Early return on mismatch.** The text says the method "need not" resolve later dependencies, so this is permissive and needs no test.
- **The method observes the current state the caller intends to inspect.** `src/sdk.rs#mod[tests]/fn[requirement_edges_and_input_freshness_use_the_sdk]` checks that a record is current against the unchanged domain. It also checks that it is not current against a changed domain with fresh content fingerprints. `crates/trust-but-verify/src/agent/tests.rs#fn[source_reads_track_optional_dependencies_and_empty_searches_remain_discovery]` checks that `is_current` is true before the source change and, after it, false only when the dependency was recorded.
- **Freshness checking has a separate observation scope from execution, and checked observations enter the new trace only when execution reads them.**
  - `graph/validation_tests.rs#fn[historical_freshness_reads_do_not_enter_the_replacement_trace]` runs `check_inputs` on the old record, then `verify`. It asserts the read log is `[2, 1]` and that the stored dependencies are only `Node(1)`.
  - `tests/contracts.rs#fn[input_checking_and_execution_keep_separate_observations]` asserts that execution re-reads node 2 and records the "after" fingerprint.
  - `tests/contracts.rs#fn[refresh_evaluates_missing_incompatible_or_changed_evidence_with_a_fresh_trace]` asserts the replacement trace holds only the explicit read of node 1.
  - `tests/contracts.rs#fn[typed_loading_reports_decode_errors_even_for_stale_evidence]` and `tests/contracts.rs#fn[criteria_keep_typed_answers_and_persist_only_when_requested]` assert that loading and executing do no input reads.
- **Declared under `check_inputs`.** `tests/contracts.rs#fn[criteria_keep_typed_answers_and_persist_only_when_requested]` calls `check_inputs` on a loaded record and asserts true.
- **A checked snapshot can be reused.** This is permissive wording, so nothing needs checking.

All of these tests carry `{test}` markers for the subject, so I found no marking gaps.
